event_chain.summary: Departmental data with resident PII accessed

summary: A malicious actor gained unauthorized access to City of Roanoke, Virginia departmental data on May 6, 2026; the city discovered it on May 11. Data potentially exposed includes residents' names, Social Security numbers, passport numbers and financial account information. The city notified affected residents by letters dated August 24, 2026, reported the incident to the FBI, and engaged security experts; it had no indication of misuse.
